questions.scenario: A massive argument breaks out during a Gully Cricket match about whether a player was 'Out' or 'Not Out'. What do you do?

options.A: I grab the ball in anger and vow to bowl the fastest, most aggressive delivery next ball to break their stumps.
options.B: I logically explain the exact 'gully rule' we agreed upon last week to prove why it was definitely out.
options.C: I dramatically dive onto the road to recreate the exact moment of the catch to show my clean technique.
options.D: I step in as the peacekeeper, calm both sides down, and declare a 'trial ball' so we can resume playing.

questions.scenario: The bell rings for the 'PT Period' (Games Period) and the teacher says you can do whatever you want. Where are you?

options.A: Sprinting straight to the football field or basketball court to exert maximum energy and dominate the game.
options.B: Sitting near the pavilion, closely observing the matches, and analyzing which team is going to lose and why.
options.C: Practicing cartwheels, stretching, or doing high martial-arts kicks on the soft grass just for fun.
options.D: Taking charge of the equipment room, organizing the teams fairly, and acting as the official umpire.

questions.scenario: You are watching a high-tension IPL match on TV with your family. What gets you the most hyped up?

options.A: A batsman smashing a monstrous 105-meter six out of the stadium, or a fast bowler clocking 150 kmph.
options.B: A clever spin bowler changing his field placement perfectly to trap the batsman into making a mistake.
options.C: A fielder doing an unbelievable, acrobatic flying dive at the boundary rope to save a certain six.
options.D: The captain making a massive, risky decision to give the 19th over to an unknown bowler, which wins them the game.

questions.scenario: You are playing a serious game of Kabaddi or Kho-Kho during the school's Annual Sports Day. What is your signature move?

options.A: Using sheer brute force to break through the defensive chain and powerfully drag three people to the midline.
options.B: Calculating the exact moment the defender shifts their body weight to score a sneaky, unexpected bonus point.
options.C: Executing a perfectly timed, highly flexible leap right over the defender's waist to escape their tackle.
options.D: Standing at the back of the court, continuously shouting commands, and directing the chain on who to target.

questions.scenario: There is a typical sibling fight at home over who gets the TV remote. How is it resolved?

options.A: I use my raw physical strength to wrestle them onto the sofa and snatch the remote out of their hands.
options.B: I trick them into looking the other way or convince them their favorite show is actually airing tomorrow.
options.C: I do a quick ninja-dodge when they lunge for it, effortlessly sliding past them to secure the remote.
options.D: I pause the fight and negotiate a strict timetable: 'You watch your cartoon now, I get the TV for the match later.'

questions.scenario: You are playing society football (or futsal) in the evening. How do you play?

options.A: I strike the ball with absolute maximum power, aiming to tear through the net and terrify the goalkeeper.
options.B: I notice the goalkeeper always leans slightly to the left, so I gently tap the ball into the bottom right corner.
options.C: I perform flashy step-overs, rainbow flicks, and smoothly dribble past three defenders like a dancer.
options.D: I play as the central midfielder, constantly checking everyone's position and shouting instructions to hold the formation.

questions.scenario: You are navigating through an extremely crowded local vegetable market or railway station. How do you move?

options.A: I push straight ahead with my broad shoulders, using my physical presence to make a clear path.
options.B: I visually map out the crowd's walking patterns and calculate the mathematically fastest diagonal shortcut.
options.C: I flexibly slide sideways, duck under people's arms, and squeeze through tight gaps without touching anyone.
options.D: I walk at the front of my group, holding my hand up, and loudly guiding everyone so nobody gets lost.

questions.scenario: Your school team is preparing for a major inter-school tournament final. How do you prepare the night before?

options.A: I eat a heavy, high-protein dinner and do 100 explosive push-ups to make sure my muscles are completely pumped.
options.B: I quietly watch old YouTube clips of the rival school's matches to pinpoint exactly where their defense is weak.
options.C: I spend an hour doing deep yoga stretches and meditation to ensure my body is perfectly loose, balanced, and calm.
options.D: I call up my teammates one by one to give them a pep talk and remind them of our core strategy.

questions.scenario: You are playing carrom with your cousins during the summer holidays. What is your playstyle?

options.A: I strike the striker with maximum finger power, hoping the raw speed smashes multiple coins into the pockets.
options.B: I geometrically calculate the rebound angles off the wooden edges to hit a coin hiding behind the queen.
options.C: I focus intensely on my sitting posture, the angle of my wrist, and a smooth, stylish flicking technique.
options.D: I partner up with the weakest younger cousin, giving them continuous instructions on exactly where to hit.

questions.scenario: What is the absolute best compliment you could ever receive from a coach or friend?

options.A: 'You are an absolute beast on the field! Your raw energy and power are completely unstoppable.'
options.B: 'You have a super sharp mind. That strategic trap you set for the opponent was pure genius.'
options.C: 'Your form and movements are so elegant and beautiful to watch. It's like poetry in motion.'
options.D: 'You are a natural born leader. The way you control the game and inspire the team is incredible.'

Power_Athlete.title: The Power / Explosive Athlete
Power_Athlete.primary_match_text: The Action-Oriented Powerhouse! You rely on raw strength, intense speed, and sheer aggression to dominate the game.
Power_Athlete.day_in_the_life: Waking up early for heavy gym sessions, eating strict high-protein diets, practicing explosive sprints, and using pure physical dominance to overwhelm opponents on the field (like a fast bowler or striker).
Power_Athlete.alternative_match_text: Weightlifter, Fast Bowler, Sprinter, Football Striker
Power_Athlete.educational_roadmap: 11th/12th (Any Stream) -> Participate in SGFI (School Games Federation of India) -> Appear for Sports Authority of India (SAI) open trials -> Pursue B.P.Ed (Bachelor of Physical Education) alongside professional training.

Tactical_Player.title: The Tactical / Strategic Player
Tactical_Player.primary_match_text: The Analytical Mastermind! You treat sports like physical chess, outsmarting your opponents by reading their minds.
Tactical_Player.day_in_the_life: Studying match footage, analyzing opponent weaknesses, mastering complex techniques (like spin bowling variations), and winning games through clever traps rather than pure muscle.
Tactical_Player.alternative_match_text: Spin Bowler, Chess Grandmaster, Table Tennis Player, E-Sports Athlete
Tactical_Player.educational_roadmap: 11th/12th (Any Stream) -> Join specialized tactical sports academies (e.g., State Chess Association or Cricket Academies) -> Compete in State/National level age-group tournaments -> B.A/B.Com/B.Sc via Sports Quota.

Agile_Performer.title: The Agile / Aesthetic Performer
Agile_Performer.primary_match_text: The Creative Acrobat! You focus on flexibility, perfect balance, and beautiful form, making your sport look like an art.
Agile_Performer.day_in_the_life: Spending hours stretching, practicing highly technical routines, maintaining a lean diet, and executing flawless, gravity-defying moves that require incredible body control and focus.
Agile_Performer.alternative_match_text: Gymnast, Martial Artist, Diver, Contemporary Dancer
Agile_Performer.educational_roadmap: 11th/12th (Any Stream) -> Enroll in specialized Gymnastics/Martial Arts Academies -> Participate in Khelo India Youth Games -> Pursue B.P.Ed or specialized NIS (National Institute of Sports) Diploma in Coaching.

Team_Captain.title: The Team Captain / Playmaker
Team_Captain.primary_match_text: The Field General! You are a natural leader who loves managing the team, making quick decisions, and guiding others to victory.
Team_Captain.day_in_the_life: Leading team meetings, calling the coin toss, deciding the formations on the field, motivating players when morale is low, and making critical split-second decisions under massive pressure.
Team_Captain.alternative_match_text: Wicketkeeper-Captain, Central Midfielder, Sports Manager, Coach
Team_Captain.educational_roadmap: 11th/12th (Any Stream) -> Captain school/college teams -> BBA/B.A in Sports Management or B.P.Ed -> Clear state-level club trials -> Pursue a Master's in Sports Administration or Coaching.
